response:
<analysis>Spring Batch 6 (Boot 4) moved the infrastructure packages (org.springframework.batch.item / repeat / support → org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.*) and the core domain types into sub-packages (Job → core.job, Step / StepContribution → core.step). The script applies that relocation table to the imports and qualified names of the case's files.</analysis>
<script>
import re

# Spring Batch 6 package moves (verified against spring-batch-core / -infrastructure 6.0.4)
MOVES = (
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.Job;", "org.springframework.batch.core.job.Job;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecution;", "org.springframework.batch.core.job.JobExecution;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.JobParameters;", "org.springframework.batch.core.job.parameters.JobParameters;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.Step;", "org.springframework.batch.core.step.Step;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.StepContribution;", "org.springframework.batch.core.step.StepContribution;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.StepExecution;", "org.springframework.batch.core.step.StepExecution;"),
)
PACKAGES = (("org.springframework.batch.item.", "org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.item."),
            ("org.springframework.batch.repeat.", "org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.repeat."),
            ("org.springframework.batch.support.", "org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.support."))


def relocate(text):
    for old, new in MOVES:
        text = text.replace("import " + old, "import " + new)
    for old, new in PACKAGES:
        text = re.sub(r"(?<![\w.])" + re.escape(old), new, text)
    return text

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = relocate(text)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: Spring Batch 6 package moves applied")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: nothing to relocate")
</script>
